description: Saves a connection between two of the person's curiosities, or a provocation on one when target_id is omitted. Both ids must be curiosities the person owns; anything else is refused. Private to the person.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

note.description: One or two sentences, in the person's own voice.

source_id.description: A curiosity id the connection starts from.

target_id.description: The other curiosity id. Omit for a provocation.

name: store_connection
title: Save a Connection Between Curiosities
